title: ReMaRL: Learning to Unmask and Remask in Frozen Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, and the order in which tokens are unmasked affects final-answer accuracy. Several methods learn unmasking policies from task rewards, but these policies cannot remask earlier predictions. Remasking lets the model correct those predictions using newly generated context. Heuristic rules guide both unmasking and remasking, while supervised remaskers learn to detect token errors. Neither approach directly optimizes these decisions for final-answer correctness. To address this gap, we introduce ReMaRL (Remasking with Reinforcement Learning), a lightweight policy that learns which tokens to unmask, retain, or remask. We train this roughly 0.3M-parameter policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) from final-answer rewards while keeping the diffusion model frozen. With LLaDA-8B-Instruct, ReMaRL achieves the highest scores among the compared unmasking and remasking policies

translated_title: ReMaRL：在冻结的扩散语言模型中学习解掩码与再掩码
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型并行生成词元，而词元被解掩码的顺序会影响最终答案的准确性。已有若干方法从任务奖励中学习解掩码策略，但这些策略无法对先前的预测进行再掩码。再掩码使模型能够利用新生成的上下文来纠正这些预测。目前，启发式规则同时指导解掩码和再掩码，而有监督的再掩码器则学习检测词元错误，但这两种方法都没有针对最终答案的正确性直接优化这些决策。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ReMaRL（基于强化学习的再掩码），这是一个轻量级策略，用于学习哪些词元应被解掩码、保留或再掩码。我们在保持扩散模型冻结的同时，使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）从最终答案奖励中训练这个约30万参数的策略。在使用LLaDA-8B-Instruct时，ReMaRL在所比较的解掩码和再掩码策略中取得了最高分数。
tldr: 提出ReMaRL，一个仅约30万参数的轻量级策略，在保持扩散语言模型冻结的情况下，通过GRPO强化学习直接优化最终答案正确性，学习决定哪些词元应被解掩码、保留或再掩码，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上超越了现有的解掩码与再掩码策略。
